title: Product Photo Lighting Without a Studio | Aidreamcapes
description: Fix product photo lighting without a studio. Upload a phone snapshot and get soft light, gentle shadows, and clean highlights on glass and metal. Start now.
h1: Product Photo Lighting for Glass, Metal, and Glossy Finishes
lead: Upload a plain snapshot and get a square photo with soft, directional light, gentle shadows, and the glow on glass and gold that usually takes a lighting kit.
secondary_keywords: skincare product photo with soft light
intro: Glass, metal, and glossy packaging are hard to shoot at home, where a window throws glare in one spot and murky shadow in another. In the example, a square perfume bottle with a faceted cap glows with pale gold liquid, its collar catches a highlight, and soft shadows fall across a marble top scattered with white blossoms.

Light like this makes a product look the way it does in person. It's useful for perfume, serums, candles, watches, and anything with a reflective surface, whether as an extra Amazon image or the first photo on your own store.
tip: Photograph your product against a plain wall with no direct sun on it, so harsh glare from the original doesn't carry into the new image.

steps.d: A phone photo on a table works, as long as the whole bottle or jar is in frame and in focus.
Try "soft morning light from the left, long shadows, marble surface" or "bright even studio light, minimal shadow."
Download the first version, then try warmer or cooler light and keep the one closest to your brand's look.

ideas.d: Warm side light through amber glass or a candle jar brings out the color of the liquid or wax.
Even light on frosted glass and gold caps suits serums, oils, and creams.
Controlled highlights on steel cases, rings, or cookware, without the hot spots of a flash photo.

faq.q: Can I get a plain white background instead of a styled scene?
faq.a: Yes. Describe "bright white background, soft even light" for a clean catalog look, or name a surface and time of day for a lifestyle feel.

faq.q: Does it work on clear glass and shiny metal?
faq.a: Those are the surfaces it helps with most. Upload a photo where the outline of the bottle or case is sharp, so edges and reflections stay crisp.

faq.q: Can I use this for skincare and fragrance listings?
faq.a: Yes. Let the photo show the bottle, the texture, and the finish, and leave claims about results, like smoother skin or all-day scent, out of the image and the listing text.
